jobs.objective: REVISE the v2 RFC 0167 P0 implementation SPEC to resolve the two v2 binding constraints C1prime and C2prime, carrying forward UNREGRESSED everything cleared through v1+v2. Start from the v2 HOLDER.md (a required context doc) — do NOT rewrite from scratch; the v2 cycle-1 collaboration ledger (also required context) gives the exact prescribed fixes in its findings and constraints. Read the v3 SEED, the v2 HOLDER.md, the v2 ledger, and the RFC in full first. DISCHARGE C1prime (operator-session token authorization, critical): v2's proof needs the operator-session token to call run.prepare so app.session_id is set and created_by_handle_id is stamped, but run.prepare requires CapabilityAdmin (registry_methods.go:110; registry_rfc0043_test.go:27) while the reused mintSessionBoundToken grants only the fixed slice {claim,write,read,review} (session_token.go:23-46,77-86), and the dispatcher authorizes BEFORE the handler (server.go:107-124) — so the operator token is rejected capability_missing before app.session_id is set; the two-terminal proof cannot execute. Adding admin to the shared slice would over-grant admin to EVERY lane token. FIX: name the operator-token capability + mint shape explicitly — the operator (human) legitimately holds run.prepare and run.start authority (today via the shared admin runtime token), so the operator-session token may carry that capability via a DISTINCT operator-token mint path (or mintSessionBoundToken parameterized with a capability set), NOT by widening the shared lane slice; keep lane tokens on the unchanged narrow {claim,write,read,review} slice; specify that a closed or expired operator session cannot keep authorizing run.prepare or stamping. Re-specify pgtest operator_session_pre_run_stamp to exercise the REAL run.prepare RPC authorization path with the minted operator token (two pre-run operator sessions for one human, two distinct words, one run each, two NON-NULL DISTINCT created_by_handle_id, whose RA != whose RB) PLUS controls: (i) an ordinary lane session token does NOT gain admin / cannot call run.prepare, (ii) a closed or expired operator session cannot prepare a run or stamp. DISCHARGE C2prime (operator_sessions read-scope grant-back, critical): v2's operator_sessions table carries BOTH principal_id and client_id (v2 §2.6) and 0021 grants table-wide SELECT to striatumd_rw (v2 §4.2(5)), so SELECT client_id, principal_id FROM operator_sessions WHERE state='active' recovers the client_id->principal_id mapping bundle 0006 deliberately closed (0006_identity_read_scope.sql:204-221; owner.go:454-468). FIX: replace the table-wide GRANT SELECT ON operator_sessions with COLUMN-LEVEL grants that EXCLUDE principal_id AND client_id (keep the liveness and state columns the runtime needs: operator_session_id, repository_id, state, last_heartbeat_at, expires_at, closed_at), OR route any identity-bearing operator-session read through a SECURITY DEFINER projection mirroring resolve_principal_for_client; confirm the runtime keeps exactly the operator-session DML it needs (mint INSERT, heartbeat and close UPDATE; the stamp does NOT read operator_sessions.principal_id — principal via the projection, handle via operator_handles). Add a two-role NEGATIVE control: SELECT client_id, principal_id FROM operator_sessions WHERE state='active' as striatumd_rw must fail 42501 (or be impossible because ungranted), with a POSITIVE control proving create + heartbeat and close + the run stamp + authorized whose and status --mine still work. CARRY FORWARD UNREGRESSED (cleared through v1+v2): R1a honesty, the R1b architecture (per-session created_by_handle_id + live-unique index + escalation walk), the v2 C1 operator_sessions storage substrate (auth_pg.go:104-156 fact), the v2 C2 projection-routed stamp, R1c flap, the R2 BEFORE UPDATE write-once trigger + bundle ordinal 0021, R3's four open questions, R4 reuse, and the four C-1..C-4 source corrections. Open the revised SPEC with an auditable 'Addressing the v2 constraints' map (C1prime RESOLVED how, C2prime RESOLVED how, carry-forwards INTACT). This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.

FIRST verify C1prime is GENUINELY resolved: does the operator-session token now authorize run.prepare END-TO-END through the REAL dispatcher path (server.go:107-124 authorizes before the handler; run.prepare needs CapabilityAdmin per registry_methods.go:110)? Is the operator-token capability granted via a DISTINCT mint path (or a parameterized mintSessionBoundToken), NOT by widening the shared {claim,write,read,review} lane slice (session_token.go:23-46)? Re-run the two-same-human-terminals proof: two pre-run operator sessions, one run each — do whose RA and whose RB return two DISTINCT NON-NULL answers through the real authorized run.prepare, or does it still stop at capability_missing / collapse created_by_handle_id to NULL? CONSTRUCT the controls: (i) does an ordinary supervised lane session token still get ONLY the narrow slice (no admin, cannot call run.prepare)? If C1prime is not genuinely buildable, if the proof still collapses, if lane tokens can gain admin, or a new material gap stands, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 1 (C1prime / operator-token authorization lens)

jobs.objective: Read the published REVISED (v3) holder SPEC, the v2 HOLDER.md, and the v2 cycle-1 ledger (its C2prime finding). Your lens is C2prime / READ-SCOPE + CARRY-FORWARD REGRESSION. FIRST verify C2prime is GENUINELY resolved: can striatumd_rw still recover the client_id->principal_id mapping from operator_sessions by ANY route — a table-wide grant residue, a leftover GRANT, a view, an inherited privilege, or a function? Does the POSITIVE control still pass: create + heartbeat and close + the run-origin stamp + authorized whose and status --mine work through the narrower grants (the stamp must resolve principal via the projection and handle via operator_handles, NOT read operator_sessions.principal_id)? THEN spend the rest on REGRESSION — verify each carry-forward survives: R1a honesty, the R1b architecture (created_by_handle_id snapshot + live-unique index + escalation walk, not re-collapsed), the v2 C1 operator_sessions storage substrate (auth_pg.go:104-156), the v2 C2 projection stamp (still no direct principal_clients.principal_id read), R1c guarded-UPDATE flap, the R2 BEFORE UPDATE write-once trigger + owner bundle ordinal 0021 (next-free, not advanced; watermark and forward-only intact), R3's four open questions, R4 reuse (no parallel identity table). Confirm the C1prime token-capability change did not over-grant or perturb owner-bundle ordering. If client_id+principal_id is still readable from operator_sessions, if the negative control is fake, or if any carry-forward regressed, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.

Publish the collaboration ledger verdict (one of accept, accept_with_findings, needs_revision, reject — a clearing verdict is accept or accept_with_findings, never `clear`).
